    Come build the AI era of travel and expense with us

    We innovate and build with the future in mind — making travel easy for frequent travelers everywhere.

    View open roles

    Who We Are

    We believe the future of travel and expense is intelligent — and it starts with our people. Navan is a fast-growing, AI-powered travel and expense platform, which means we’re constantly adding fresh perspectives and talent to our mission-driven teams. Together, we’re building a culture that is just as dynamic, collaborative, and forward-thinking as the technology we deploy for our customers every day.

    Learn more about us

    How We Work

    We move fast, aim high, and reject the status quo. We don’t follow industry standards — we set them. Navan is a meritocratic, high-ownership culture where pushing boundaries and delivering high output is rewarded. Each teammate is in the driver’s seat here, with strong autonomy and accountability. We pair a high-talent-density community with a high-velocity environment so you can do the most definitive and rewarding work of your career. If you prioritize growth, ownership, and you’re excited at the chance to redefine an entire industry, you’ll thrive here.

    Meet the Innovators

    In 2015, Navan co-founders Ariel Cohen and Ilan Twig, tired of fighting with hard-to-use legacy travel and expense tools — and dealing with the resulting collateral damage — created a new corporate travel solution. The tool enabled users to easily book, view, and manage their travel and expenses in a single platform. Relentlessly innovative, the pair combined AI, data science, and a seamless user experience to take the first steps on the path toward building what would become Navan.

    Perks and Benefits

    Flexible Vacation

    Take time off when you need it, just work with your manager.

    Healthcare

    Medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.

    Commuter benefits

    Transportation benefits available to help ease your commute*.

    Parental leave

    Paid parental leave is available to all new parents: 16 weeks for the birthing parent and 10 weeks for the non-birthing parent.

    Fuel for Connection

    We provide in-office snacks and lunches*, fostering community and in-person connections.

    Pet Friendly

    Pet insurance with preferred rates and dog friendly offices*.

    401k

    We care about your future and offer a 401k retirement plan program.

    IATAN

    Employees can register and receive access to thousands of travel related discounts.

    Connectivity Allowance

    We support our employees ability to work seamlessly and confidently while from home and offer a bi-weekly stipend.

    Navan Personal Travel

    All employees can book leisure travel through Navan and get the same discounted rates.

    Headspace

    Access this platform with a wide range of mental health resources.

    Invest In Our Success

    Purchase company stock at a discount through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).*

    About Navan

    Navan is the global AI-powered business travel and expense management platform that makes travel easy for frequent travelers. powering travel programs at more than 10,000 companies, including Canva, HelloFresh, DoorDash, Duolingo, and Steelcase. The platform simplifies travel, payments, and expense management with intuitive tools for booking, automated payments with built-in virtual cards, and seamless expense reporting. Navan delivers exceptional customer satisfaction, with a 96% CSAT and 43 NPS. Founded in 2015 by Ariel Cohen and Ilan Twig as TripActions, Navan reported $613M in LTM revenue and $7.6B in LTM gross booking volume, each for the twelve months ended July 31, 2025. The company aims to empower organizations worldwide to make corporate travel smarter and more efficient. Learn more at navan.com.
